title: Vanishing of derived affine sections above a basis-acyclic lower tail
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V an affine open, and F an integer-indexed complex of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that for every affine open W contained in V, every integer r and every positive integer p, H^p(W,H^r(F)) [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor] is zero. Write QF for its image in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], tau_{<a} for the standard strictly lower truncation [def-weil-t-structure], and S for evaluation on V, an additive left exact functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For all integers a and i with a <= i, H^i(RS(tau_{<a}(QF))) is zero. No K-injectivity of F is assumed. The derived category universes are arbitrary.

source.place: Tag 0BKT (lemma-cohomology-over-U-trivial), applied to the strictly lower tail; Tag 0D64 (lemma-is-limit-dimension); Tag 071B (lemma-K-injective), compatible resolution model

proof.text: Construct the derived sections truncation tower using the affine-basis reconstruction intermediate theorem.

Use the stabilization intermediate theorem, then the Milnor short exact sequence and eventual-isomorphism derived-limit vanishing. The degree-i tower is zero, so its inverse limit is zero and the first derived limit of degree i−1 vanishes.
Transport abelian-group vanishing back across the exact forgetful functor using the comparison isomorphism.

theorem affineBasisDerivedSections_lowerTail_isZero
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op V)))]
    (F : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (a i : ℤ) (hai : a ≤ i) :
    let S := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (op V)
    letI : S.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj (op V)).Additive)
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
      (S.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLT a).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F))))
